callees.name: _cache_rate
callees.pre_condition: rows is a list of (cache_read_count, total_count) tuples where both elements are non-negative integers and, for each tuple, cache_read_count ≤ total_count.
callees.post_condition: Returns a tuple (rate, total_cr, total_tokens) where: rate is the quotient of the sum of all cache_read_counts divided by the sum of all total_counts, or 0.0 when the denominator sum is zero; total_cr is the sum of all cache_read_counts; total_tokens is the sum of all total_counts. All three values are non-negative and rate is in [0.0, 1.0].

callees.name: _fmt_tokens
callees.post_condition: Returns a human-readable string representation of n using appropriate magnitude suffixes (e.g., K, M, B) and at most one decimal place of precision. The returned string contains no Rich markup and is suitable for inline display.
